claim_scope: one-record train-only loss/capacity diagnosis; not model promotion
hypothesis: Replacing pointwise Smooth-L1 with batch energy-normalized squared error aligned to full-field relative L2 will prevent the zero-field optimum and let both WFP and FNO memorize one fixed background record materially below relative L2 1.0.
single_conceptual_change: loss normalization only; reuse the exact E1 cache, feature encoder and architectures
record_selection: smallest lexical fit/uniform sample shared by all four lanes
physical_objective: sum squared coefficient error divided by sum squared target coefficient with 1e-8 denominator floor
failure_signal: If either architecture remains at relative L2 >=0.95 under one-record memorization, reject its source-to-field parameterization before another 256-record run.
